title: Extension by zero from finite disjoint opens is a biproduct
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring, X any scheme, F a sheaf of Λ-modules on its small etale site, n a natural number, and U_a (a in Fin n) pairwise disjoint open subsets. Put W = union_a U_a and let j_W and j_a be the open inclusions. There exists an isomorphism j_W! j_W* F ≅ ⨁_a j_a! j_a* F. No curve, finiteness, torsion or constructibility assumption is needed, and n = 0 is allowed. Extension by zero is [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and the biproduct is [def-weil-additive-category].

source.place: Theorem 03SC, proof, fourth paragraph; Lemma 0A5C. Primary text checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SC and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A5C.

proof.text: Inside W form φ: ⨁_a i_a! i_a* (F|W) → F|W by taking the biproduct desc of the adjunction counits. The inclusions i_a:U_a→W are jointly surjective by the definition of W.

For a fixed a, restriction P=i_a* kills every summand indexed by b≠a, since the images of i_a and i_b are disjoint. P of the a-th inclusion is invertible, with inverse P of the a-th projection: one identity is inclusion-projection, the other follows from the total biproduct identity, whose other terms vanish.

The composite of P of the a-th inclusion with Pφ is P of the a-th counit. This is invertible by the right triangle identity and the invertible unit of i_a! ⊣ i_a*. Thus Pφ is invertible. The jointly-surjective restriction criterion, proved from conservative geometric stalks, makes φ invertible. This also applies to the empty cover of the empty W.

Apply the additive functor j_W! to φ and use Functor.mapBiproduct. Identify j_W! i_a! with j_a! by uniqueness of left adjoints to the composite inverse image, and identify i_a* j_W* with j_a* by upperStarComp. The component isomorphisms induce a biproduct isomorphism, giving the stated result.

    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hU : Pairwise (fun a b ↦ Disjoint (U a : Set X) (U b))) :

      ((((⨆ a, U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          (((⨆ a, U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) ≅
        ⨁ (fun a ↦ (((U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          (((U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F))))
